source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of UV-visible spectroscopy (PDF 190-192).

blocks.text: Ultraviolet-visible (UV-Vis) spectroscopy sab se zyada use hone wali analytical techniques (tajziye ke tareeqon) mein se hai, kyun ke yeh bohat kaam ki aur use karne mein aasan hai. Is mein UV-Vis roshni sample mein se guzari jati hai aur roshni ki transmittance (kitni roshni paar guzri) naapi jati hai. Absorbance (A, kitni roshni jazb hui) transmittance (T) se is formula se nikalti hai: A = −log (T). UV-Vis spectrum mukhtalif wavelengths par kisi cheez ki absorbance dikhata hai. Kisi wavelength par kitni absorbance hogi, yeh molecule ke electronic structure (electrons ki tarteeb) par munhasir hai.
Compound mein electrons ki qismein yeh ho sakti hain:

items: n electrons (non-bonded electrons, yani lone pairs)

blocks.text: Sigma bonding orbitals ki energy π bonding orbitals se kam hai, aur π bonding orbitals ki energy non-bonding orbitals se kam hai. Jab sahi frequency ki electromagnetic radiation jazb hoti hai to electron in orbitals (π ya n) mein se kisi khaali orbital mein chala jata hai, aam taur par anti-bonding orbital σ* ya π* mein. UV-Vis spectroscopy 200-800 nm ki wavelengths se electronic energy levels ki tabdeeliyan parhti hai. Yeh tabdeeliyan π ya non-bonding orbitals se electrons ke oopar jane se hoti hain, jaisa Figure 29.4 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Tawanai ki satahon ka khaaka, oopar jaata energy ka teer. Oopar se satahein: sigma* (anti-bonding) aur pi* (anti-bonding), 'These are normally empty'; n (non-bonding), 'These contain lone pairs'; pi (bonding) aur sigma (bonding), 'These contain normal bonding pairs of electrons'. Chhe oopar jaate teer: sigma se pi* aur sigma*, pi se pi* aur sigma*, aur n se pi* aur sigma* tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 29.4: Electrons ka kam tawanai se zyada tawanai ki satahon par jana (kitab ki Figure 29.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 29.4 mein beech wali sabz satah ko 'n (anti-bonding)' likha hai; yeh ghalat hai. n electrons lone pairs hain, yani non-bonding, is liye hamare khaake mein 'n (non-bonding)' likha hai. Khaake mein chhe teer hain: sigma, pi aur n, teeno se pi* aur sigma* tak.

Har soorat mein aik electron bhare hue (filled) orbital se khaali anti-bonding orbital mein excite hota hai. Har chhalang (jump) ke liye aik khaas wavelength ki roshni se energy li jati hai, yani woh wavelength jazb hoti hai.

items: pi bonding orbitals se pi anti-bonding orbitals tak (π se π*)
non-bonding orbitals se pi anti-bonding orbitals tak (n se π*)
non-bonding orbitals se sigma anti-bonding orbitals tak (n se σ*)

blocks.text: Neeche buta-1,3-diene, CH₂=CH-CH=CH₂, ka saada UV-visible absorption spectrum hai. Is ki sab se oonchi absorption 217 nm par hai; jis wavelength par sab se zyada absorption ho use λₘₐₓ kehte hain. Yeh UV hissa hai, is liye koi visible roshni jazb nahi hoti aur compound be-rang (colourless) hai. Is mein non-bonding electrons nahi hain, is liye (spectrometer ki range mein) sirf pi bonding se pi anti-bonding orbitals tak ki chhalangen hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Absorbance (0 se 1.0) aur wavelength (200 se 300 nm) ka graph. Khat 200 nm par taqreeban 0.33 se shuru ho kar taqreeban 0.86 ki choti tak uthta hai aur 250 nm tak taqreeban sifar par gir kar 300 nm tak seedha rehta hai. Choti par likha hai lambda max = 217 nm, aur 'Maximum absorption at this wavelength'.
blocks.caption: Figure 29.5: Buta-1,3-diene ka absorption spectrum (kitab ki Figure 29.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph ki sab se oonchi jagah (choti) woh wavelength hai jis par butadiene sab se zyada roshni jazb karta hai: lambda max = 217 nm. Yeh 400 nm se kam, yani UV hissa hai, is liye butadiene be-rang hai.

Kisi compound ki λₘₐₓ is baat par bohat munhasir hai ke us mein conjugation (double aur single bonds ka baari baari aana) kitna lamba hai. Is ko samajhne ke liye butadiene, hexatriene aur octatetraene ka muqabla karein.

blocks.alt: Teen conjugated zanjeeron ke skeletal formule jin mein double aur single bonds baari baari aate hain: butadiene (do double bonds) 217 nm, hexatriene (teen double bonds) 257 nm aur octatetraene (chaar double bonds) 290 nm.
blocks.caption: Butadiene, hexatriene aur octatetraene apni lambda max qeematon ke saath (29.4 mein chhapi banawaton ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab octatetraene ki qeemat sirf '290' chhaapti hai, bina unit ke; yeh 290 nm hai.

Conjugated system mein atoms lambi zanjeer (chain) par electrons share karte hain. Compound jitna zyada conjugated ho, us ke energy levels utne zyada aur un ke darmiyan faasle (gaps) utne chhote hote hain. Chhote gaps ki wajah se electron ko neeche se oopar ke level par bhejne ke liye kam energy chahiye. Roshni ki energy us ki frequency par munhasir hai, is liye chhote gaps wala compound kam energy (kam frequency) wali roshni jazb karta hai; isi liye zyada conjugated compounds aksar chamakdar rangon wale hote hain. Lambi wavelength ki roshni mein energy kam hoti hai, is liye yeh compounds lambi wavelength jazb karte hain, yani un ki λₘₐₓ lambi hoti hai. Matlab compound mein jitne zyada double bonds aapas mein jure (conjugated) hon, us ki λₘₐₓ utni zyada hogi. Aam taur par zanjeer mein har aik double bond barhane se λₘₐₓ taqreeban 30 se 40 nm barh jati hai. Is number se compound mein conjugation ki wusat (kitna lamba hai) maloom ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: a) UV/Vis spectroscopy mein kaun si electronic transition sab se kam energy leti hai: i) σ→σ* ii) π→π* iii) n→σ* iv) n→π*? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: n→π*. Non-bonding (n) electrons bhare hue orbitals mein sab se oonchi energy par hain aur π* khaali orbitals mein sab se neeche hai, is liye in dono ka gap sab se chhota hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Barhti λₘₐₓ ki tarteeb mein likhein: i) CH₃CH₂C(=CH₂)CH=CHCOCH₃ ii) CH₂=CHCOCH₃ iii) CH₂=CHCH=CHCOCH₃
blocks.explanation: (ii) < (iii) < (i). (ii) mein do conjugated double bonds hain (C=C aur C=O); (iii) aur (i) mein teen teen; (i) ki conjugated chain par alkyl (ethyl) group bhi laga hai jo λₘₐₓ thori aur barha deta hai. (Structures kitab ki drawings se parhe gaye.)

blocks.prompt: c) Kya CH₃CHOHCH₃ UV-Vis hisse mein qabil-e-zikr absorption dikhayega?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Propan-2-ol mein sirf σ aur n electrons hain; is ke σ→σ* aur n→σ* transitions ko 200 nm se chhoti wavelength chahiye, jo 200-800 nm ki range se bahar hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Hara (green) tamatar aur paka hua surkh tamatar alag rang ke hote hain. Hare tamatar mein chlorophyll zyada hota hai, jab ke surkh tamatar mein lycopene hota hai. In dono compounds ki λₘₐₓ alag hai, is liye visible range mein in ka rang bhi alag hai.

blocks.title: Spectrum se complex ka rang
blocks.text: Agar transition metal complex nazar aane wali roshni ke kisi hisse mein jazb kare to woh complementary rang ka dikhta hai (Chapter 18, colour wheel): narangi roshni jazb karne wala complex neela dikhta hai.

items: Ahem transitions: π→π*, n→π*, n→σ*; n→π* sab se kam energy leti hai.
Zyada conjugation: chhote gaps, lambi λₘₐₓ (217, 257, 290 nm).
